run_vqa_evaluation: run the mDETR VQA evaluation script on the GQA validation dataset with a checkpoint
run_evaluate_function: run the evaluate function to compute loss metrics for a mDETR model on a data loader
run_main_function: run the main function to initialize distributed mode load a checkpoint and evaluate the model
review_evaluate_function: review the evaluate function that computes scaled and unscaled loss metrics across distributed processes
review_main_function: review the main function that sets up the mDETR model matcher loss and runs VQA evaluation
